create_mag_cache_config: create a MagCacheConfig with threshold, max_skip_steps, retention_ratio, and mag_ratios for transformer model inference
run_mag_cache_calibration: run MagCache calibration mode to compute magnitude ratios for a specific model and scheduler
apply_mag_cache_hooks: apply MagCache hooks to a transformer module to enable residual caching and block skipping during inference
interpolate_mag_ratios: interpolate a tensor of magnitude ratios to a target length using nearest neighbor interpolation
skip_computation_with_residual: skip transformer block computation and apply cached residual when accumulated error stays below threshold
